column1: A WSI of colorectal cancer with low-grade tumor budding at low resolution with visually descriptive characteristics of a relatively cohesive invasive tumor front, continuous glandular tumor borders, limited small detached tumor clusters in the surrounding stroma, mild stromal reaction near the invasion front, and preserved relationship between tumor glands and adjacent tissue.

A WSI of colorectal cancer with intermediate-grade tumor budding at low resolution with visually descriptive characteristics of a moderately irregular invasive tumor front, partial fragmentation of glandular tumor margins, scattered detached tumor clusters extending into the stroma, moderate desmoplastic reaction, and focal disruption of the boundary between tumor and surrounding tissue.

A WSI of colorectal cancer with high-grade tumor budding at low resolution with visually descriptive characteristics of a highly irregular and fragmented invasive tumor front, numerous small detached tumor foci spreading into surrounding stroma, prominent desmoplastic response, infiltrative tumor growth, and loss of a smooth boundary between tumor regions and adjacent tissue.

A WSI of colorectal cancer with low-grade tumor budding at high resolution with visually descriptive characteristics of rare isolated single tumor cells or small clusters at the invasive front, approximately 0 to 4 tumor buds in a 20× hotspot field, mostly cohesive malignant glands, limited stromal separation of tumor cells, and minimal scattered budding foci.

A WSI of colorectal cancer with intermediate-grade tumor budding at high resolution with visually descriptive characteristics of multiple isolated single tumor cells or small clusters at the invasive front, approximately 5 to 9 tumor buds in a 20× hotspot field, irregular glandular edges, stromal infiltration by detached tumor cells, and focal tumor cell dissociation from main tumor glands.

A WSI of colorectal cancer with high-grade tumor budding at high resolution with visually descriptive characteristics of numerous isolated single tumor cells and small clusters at the invasive front, 10 or more tumor buds in a 20× hotspot field, marked tumor cell dissociation, stromal invasion by scattered malignant cells, irregular nuclear atypia, and close interaction between budding tumor cells and reactive stroma.
